Event 608 records deletion of the matching failed reply flow at 02:39:50.3077546 UTC, 355.2 microseconds after the drop.
The IOCTL PID is stable svchost.exe across capture snapshots and matches hns in the subsequent service snapshot. This does not identify the upstream HNS caller.

limitations: ControlValidation export did not hit its query limit, but circular VFP retention and event loss are not independently audited.
